lines.en: label beachsevenchika2:
scene chikatells1
: Oh...hi.
: Hey, Chika. I didn’t see you around yesterday. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chika。昨天没见着你。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Just...going to breakfast. Nothing special.
lines.zh: : 就……去吃早饭。没什么特别的。

lines.en: : Cool.
lines.zh: : 挺好。

lines.en: : Yes. It {i}is{/i} cool.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}的。挺好。

lines.en: : Very cool.
lines.zh: : 非常好。

lines.en: : Okay. You seem weird today. Something is going on.
lines.zh: : 好了。你今天看起来怪怪的。有事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I wasn’t prepared to see you and I don’t know how to act.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我没准备好见到你，不知道该怎么表现。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize that was something you needed to prepare for.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这还需要你准备。

lines.en: : It wasn’t always. But life is a lot more complicated now and I haven’t completely rediscovered myself yet.
lines.zh: : 以前不需要。可现在生活复杂多了，而我还没有完全重新找回自己。

lines.en: : Is that...something I can help with? Or something that is simply a symptom of me leading you on for so long?
lines.zh: : 那是……我能帮上忙的事吗？还是说，那只是我这么长时间吊着你的一个症状？

lines.en: scene chikatells2
: I mean...I wouldn’t say you {i}led me on...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……我不会说你{i}吊着我{/i}……

lines.en: : I would. That is kind of literally what happened by not being outwardly honest with you and allowing you to keep thinking we were exclusive.
lines.zh: : 我会。没有对你坦诚、还让你一直以为我们是独占的，这他妈就是字面意义上的吊着你。

lines.en: : True but, to be fair, it’s not like I’m entirely {i}blameless.{/i} Like, how was {i}I{/i} supposed to know that Niki was {i}actually{/i} your childhood friend and that you were sleeping with her too.
lines.zh: : 没错，不过说句公道话，我也不是完全没有{i}责任{/i}。比如，{i}我{/i}怎么可能知道 Niki {i}其实{/i}是你青梅竹马，而且你还跟她上床。

lines.en: : Probably from me telling you that.
lines.zh: : 大概是我告诉过你这件事。

lines.en: : Right, but why would I {i}believe{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 对，可我为什么要{i}信{/i}？

lines.en: : Probably because her little sister is in your class and has not been candid about being in love with me since she was a kid.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为她妹妹在你班上，而且从小爱上我这件事从来就没藏着掖着。

lines.en: scene chikatells3
: Love is blind, okay?!
lines.zh: : 爱情是盲目的，行了吧？！

lines.en: : Like the TV show?
lines.zh: : 像那个电视节目一样？

lines.en: : How do you even know about that?! You don’t watch TV!
lines.zh: : 你到底怎么会知道那个的？！你又不看电视！

lines.en: : No, but Niki does. And I have known her since we were both children, so-
lines.zh: : 是不看，可 Niki 看。而且我从小就认识她，所以——

lines.en: : Yes, I’m aware of that now and don’t need to be reminded anymore!
lines.zh: : 对，我现在知道了，不用再提醒了！

lines.en: : Sorry. Just making sure.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。确认一下而已。

lines.en: : Either way, I get it now! My perfect dream world has been shattered and I must now face the fact that I don’t actually have the perfect storybook romance with a cool older guy I {i}thought{/i} I did.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我现在懂了！我那个完美的梦世界已经碎了，我现在必须面对一个事实：我并没有我{i}以为{/i}的那种、和酷大叔的完美童话爱情。

lines.en: scene chikatells4
: It was...naive of me to expect everything to work out perfectly. So why don’t we just both share some of the blame and try to move on or something?...
lines.zh: : 我指望一切都完美收场，是……太天真了。所以我们要不就各担一半责任，然后试着往前走什么的？……

lines.en: : Chika, do you really think {i}I’m{/i} still the right person for you? Like, be honest.
lines.zh: : Chika，你真觉得{i}我{/i}仍然是适合你的人吗？说实话。

lines.en: scene chikatells5
: What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 什么意思？……

lines.en: : I mean you obviously don’t want this. You’re just clinging to me now because you’re afraid of losing me or something. You could do so much better and we both know it.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你显然不想要这个。你现在只是因为害怕失去我之类的才赖着我不放。你能找到好得多的人，这一点我们俩都清楚。

lines.en: : Are you actually breaking up with me then?...
lines.zh: : 那你这是要跟我分手吗？……

lines.en: scene chikatells6
: {i}Hah...{/i}do you want to come inside? This probably isn’t a conversation we should have in the hall.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}你要不要进来？这种对话大概不该在走廊里谈。

lines.en: : If you’re going to break up with me, you can do it here. Don’t invite me in for it.
lines.zh: : 如果你是想跟我分手，就在这儿分。别为了分手还请我进去。

lines.en: : I am entering my room now. You may follow if you wish to continue this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我要进房间了。你想继续这场对话就跟上。

lines.en: scene chikatells7
: Well, of course I want to continue the conversation! As it stands, I don’t know if I still have a boyfriend or not!
lines.zh: : 我当然想继续！照现在这情况，我都不知道自己还有没有男朋友！

lines.en: scene chikatells8
: I’m surprised you’re still calling me that, honestly. I figured that, if anything, knowing you’re sharing with Niki would dissuade you from even {i}wanting{/i} the title of “girlfriend.”
lines.zh: : 说实话，你还这么叫我，我挺意外的。我还以为，知道你在跟 Niki 分享之后，你连「女朋友」这个名分都不{i}想{/i}要了。

lines.en: : I just don’t know what I’d call myself otherwise. Like, we’re clearly more than just {i}friends{/i} and it’s not like I’m trying to become your mistress or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道除此之外我该怎么称呼自己。比如，我们显然不止是{i}朋友{/i}，而我也没打算变成你的情妇什么的。

lines.en: : And I’m not trying to make you into that. So whatever you want to call yourself is fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我也没打算把你变成那个。所以你想怎么称呼自己都行。

lines.en: scene chikatells9
: Wait, are you {i}not{/i} dumping me then? Because it seemed like you were taking me in here to do that.
lines.zh: : 等等，所以你{i}不{/i}甩我？因为看起来你带我进来就是要干这个的。

lines.en: : Of course not. What sort of idiot would let a girl like you go?
lines.zh: : 当然不甩。什么样的白痴会放你这样的女孩走？

lines.en: scene chikatells10
: I’d much rather you just suffer than deal with not having you at all.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿你继续受苦，也不愿面对完全没有你的日子。

lines.en: : That’s both super mean and super cute at the same time! I don’t know how I’m supposed to interpret it!
lines.zh: : 这话又超级伤人又超级可爱！我都不知道该怎么理解！

lines.en: : Sit down. Let’s talk.
lines.zh: : 坐下。我们谈谈。

lines.en: scene chikatells11
: Uhh...should we maybe, like...clean up first? Looks like you...were busy last night.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们要不要，就是……先收拾一下？看起来你……昨晚挺忙的。

lines.en: : Don’t be too impressed. The smallest pile is mine. I’m not sure how Imani and Wakana are doing, though.
lines.zh: : 别太佩服。最小那堆是我的。不过我不知道 Imani 和 Wakana 现在怎么样了。

lines.en: : I heard Miss Watabe left this morning. Too hungover, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我听说 Watabe 老师今早走了。也许是宿醉太严重？

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}maybe.{/i} I haven’t really talked to her yet.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}也许吧。{/i}我还没怎么跟她说过话。

lines.en: scene chikatells12
: This feels kinda weird, honestly. The vibes are totally different from when the two of us went to the ryokan I won tickets for.
lines.zh: : 说实话感觉挺怪的。氛围跟我们俩去我中奖的那家旅馆那次完全不同。

lines.en: : Yeah. For one, I can still breathe. I learned things about you that weekend I hope no one else ever learns.
lines.zh: : 是啊。比如，我还能呼吸。那个周末我见识到了一些关于你的事，我希望没有别人会知道。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, I know you...aren’t as {i}open{/i} to me being with anyone else as I am with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，我知道你……对我也跟别人在一起这件事，没有我对你的那么{i}开放{/i}。

lines.en: : Let’s not pretend you’re okay with it either, Chika. No more hiding things from each other. You hate who I am, but you love me at the same time. And that’s perfectly normal.
lines.zh: : 别装作你就真的无所谓，Chika。别再对彼此隐瞒了。你恨我这个人，同时又爱我。这再正常不过。

lines.en: : Well, don’t sound {i}too{/i} beat up over it.
lines.zh: : 行吧，别说得好像你{i}多{/i}难过似的。

lines.en: : I don’t sound “beat up” because I’ve been waiting for this since we first got involved. You were always going to wind up hurting like this and it was always going to be because of me.
lines.zh: : 我听起来一点都不「难过」，因为从我们在一起那天起我就在等这一天。你迟早会这样受伤，而始作俑者永远是我。

lines.en: : Would it have killed you to at least {i}warn{/i} me, though?
lines.zh: : 可你至少{i}提醒{/i}我一下会死吗？

lines.en: : I’ve obviously had my fair share of tragedy, Sensei. But finding out you weren’t as faithful as I thought you were hit me just as hard as the rest of the terrible stuff I’ve been through.
lines.zh: : 我当然也经历过不少悲剧，Sensei。可发现你没我以为的那么专一，对我的打击跟我经历过的其他烂事一样重。

lines.en: : It’s just...been so much, you know? Like, I thought {i}you{/i} were the thing all of my hard work finally landed me. And that things would finally start to get a little easier so long as we were in love.
lines.zh: : 只是……太多了，你知道吗？就像，我本以为你是我所有努力最终换{i}来{/i}的那个东西。以为只要我们在相爱，一切终于会开始变得容易一点。

lines.en: : Turns out, I have never been more wrong about anything in my life. And that it’s all even {i}harder{/i} now because I fell for someone like you.
lines.zh: : 结果我这辈子从没有在任何事上错得这么离谱。而现在一切反而{i}更难{/i}了，因为我爱上的是你这样的人。

lines.en: : Do you regret it?
lines.zh: : 你后悔吗？

lines.en: scene chikatells13
: It’s okay if you do, Chika. And if you’re worried about hurting my feelings, don’t be. You’ve more or less earned the right to do that whenever you want now.
lines.zh: : 后悔也没关系，Chika。你要是怕伤我的心，别怕。你现在基本上已经挣到了随时伤我的权利。

lines.en: : I feel like “regret” isn’t the right word.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「后悔」不是合适的词。

lines.en: : Like...sometimes it {i}feels{/i} like it is. And I look back at all that’s happened and I’m just...fucking {i}angry.{/i} At you. At me. Even at Niki, who hasn’t technically done anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 就像……有时候{i}感觉{/i}是后悔。我回头看发生的一切，就只是……他妈的{i}愤怒{/i}。对你。对我。甚至对 Niki——严格来说她并没做错什么。

lines.en: : {i}Regretting{/i} it makes it sound like I wish it never happened, though. And that’s not true. I just wish it didn’t hurt so much.
lines.zh: : 可说{i}后悔{/i}，听起来像是我希望这一切从没发生过。那不是真的。我只是希望它没那么疼。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry it did. But I’ll be here so long as you need me to be here. And I’m still more than happy to fill out a page or two in that “storybook” you want. I can’t do it all, though. So if there’s someone-
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉它这么疼。但你需要我在多久，我就会在多久。我也仍然非常乐意为你要的那本「童话」填上一两页。但我填不满全部。所以如果有别人——

lines.en: : What if there {i}is{/i} someone?
lines.zh: : 如果{i}真有{/i}那个人呢？

lines.en: scene chikatells14
scene chikatells15
: What if...hypothetically speaking...there {i}is{/i} someone else I’ve developed...{i}feelings{/i} for?
lines.zh: : 如果……假设说……有另一个让我产生了……{i}感情{/i}的人呢？

lines.en: : And what if it made more sense to be with {i}them{/i} than it does with you in every possible way?
lines.zh: : 如果跟{i}他们{/i}在一起，在任何意义上都比跟你在一起更说得通呢？

lines.en: : What if that person brought me the same sort of joy {i}you{/i} did, just without the fear of them sleeping with everyone I know and breaking my heart in the process?
lines.zh: : 如果那个人给我带来和{i}你{/i}一样的快乐，只是不用担心她会去睡我认识的每一个人、还顺便把我的心碾碎呢？

lines.en: : Would you want me to be with that person so long as it brings me happiness? Or would you {i}really{/i} rather I continue suffering just so {i}you{/i} can feel a little less terrible inside?
lines.zh: : 只要这能让我幸福，你会希望我跟那个人在一起吗？还是你{i}真的{/i}宁愿我继续受苦，只为了让{i}你{/i}心里好受一点？

lines.en: : It’s not an easy question, is it?
lines.zh: : 这问题不好回答，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you see what I’ve been living with now? The things I’ve had to think because of {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在你看到我一直过的是什么日子了吧？因为{i}你{/i}，我不得不去想的那些事？

lines.en: scene chikatells16
: I’m in {i}high school.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我还在上{i}高中{/i}。

lines.en: : Look at what you’ve done to me.
lines.zh: : 看看你把我变成了什么样。

lines.en: : Look at who I am now.
lines.zh: : 看看现在的我。

lines.en: : I’m supposed to be worried about my homework or what my plans are this weekend. Not which one of my friends my teacher is fucking tonight or how I’m supposed to keep the lights on with a part-time job.
lines.zh: : 我本该担心的是作业，或者这个周末有什么安排。而不是我的老师今晚要操我哪个朋友，或者我该怎么靠一份兼职维持家里的灯。

lines.en: : What if I want to be normal? Just for a little bit? Date someone my age? Someone I relate to. Who I’m attracted to. Who I can see myself growing older with when you’ve already gone and done that without me.
lines.zh: : 如果我想正常一点呢？就一小会儿？跟同龄人约会？跟我合得来的人。我为之心动的人。我可以看到自己和他一起变老的人——而你已经先我一步老去了，没带上我。

lines.en: : Are these things you want to keep from me, Sensei? Are these feelings I should ignore just to make {i}you{/i} feel better?
lines.zh: : 这些也是{i}你{/i}想从我身上夺走的东西吗，Sensei？这些感觉我就该忽略掉，只为了让你好受些？

lines.en: scene chikatells17
: Is that...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: scene chikatells18
: Is someone expecting you?...
lines.zh: : 有人在等你？……

lines.en: : Yes, but-
lines.zh: : 是，可是——

lines.en: : Just answer it. I’m not going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 接吧。我不会跑。

lines.en: scene chikatells19
: It’ll just take a minute, okay? I made plans with Rin, but I can have her wait a little longer since this is obviously-
lines.zh: : 就一分钟，好吗？我跟 Rin 约好了，不过我可以让她再等一会儿，因为这事显然——

lines.en: : It’s fine. I can wait.
lines.zh: : 没事。我可以等。

lines.en: : Just one second. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 就一秒。抱歉。

lines.en: scene chikatells20
: Hello?...
: No, I’m not {i}ghosting{/i} you. Just in the middle of something right now.
lines.zh: : 不，我没有要{i}疏远{/i}你。只是现在手头有点事。

lines.en: : No, I’m still coming. I’ll just be a few minutes late.
lines.zh: : 不，我还会去的。只是会晚几分钟。

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah, see you then.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好，到时候见。

lines.en: scene chikatells21
: Sorry, so-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，所以——

lines.en: : Feels like it was just the other day me and {i}her{/i} were meeting up here while {i}you{/i} were off doing your own thing.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像前两天，我和{i}她{/i}还在这儿幽会，而{i}你{/i}在外面忙自己的事。

lines.en: : Sure, but I feel like there’s something more important you’re not telling me right now.
lines.zh: : 是，可我觉得你现在还有更重要的事没告诉我。

lines.en: scene chikatells22
: It’s kind of funny...How you bring up something like “regrets” and then immediately {i}that{/i} happens.
lines.zh: : 有点好笑……你刚提起「后悔」什么的，紧接着就发生了{i}这事{/i}。

lines.en: : Imagine I said yes to her back then? How different things would be right now?
lines.zh: : 想象一下，如果那时我答应了她？现在一切会多么不同？

lines.en: : How you wouldn’t be getting that call at {i}all{/i} and I wouldn’t be on the brink of tears in the same room you probably slept with someone {i}else{/i} last night? How did any of this happen?
lines.zh: : 你就{i}根本{/i}不会接到那个电话，而我也不会在——你昨晚大概刚跟{i}别人{/i}睡过的同一个房间里——含着泪。这一切到底是怎么发生的？

lines.en: : How did we get here?...
lines.zh: : 我们怎么走到这一步的？……

lines.en: : Chika...is there-
lines.zh: : Chika，有没有——

lines.en: scene chikatells23
: A few months ago, I went into Rin’s room to console her after her mom caught her trying to sext you.
lines.zh: : 几个月前，我走进 Rin 的房间去安慰她，因为她妈妈抓到她想给你发色情短信。

lines.en: : She thought I was going to be mad because she knew how much I love you. And that I wouldn’t approve of her chasing after you next despite the two of us being such good friends.
lines.zh: : 她以为我会生气，因为她知道我有多爱你。还以为我不会同意她接着追你，尽管我们俩是那么好的朋友。

lines.en: scene chikatells24
: And I {i}was{/i} mad. Furious, even. But not because of that.
lines.zh: : 而我确实生气了。甚至怒不可遏。但不{i}是{/i}因为那个。

lines.en: : It was because I imagined you hurting her. I imagined the confusion she hasn’t had the chance to face yet. I imagined you touching her the way you touch me.
lines.zh: : 是因为我想象你会伤害她。我想象那种她还没机会去面对的困惑。我想象你像碰我那样碰她。

lines.en: : It made my blood boil. But it all happened so fast. So I thought to myself, “What’s the best way to make all of this stop?”
lines.zh: : 那让我血液沸腾。可一切都发生得太快了。于是我对自己说：「让这一切停下来的最好办法是什么？」

lines.en: : What can {i}I{/i} do to comfort her? To comfort {i}both{/i} of us and stop all of these terrible, sad feelings?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}能做什么去安慰她？去安慰我们{i}两个{/i}，让所有这些糟糕又伤心的感觉停下来？

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: scene chikatells25
: I pushed her down on the bed. I took her panties off. And then I ate her out.
lines.zh: : 我把她推倒在床上。我脱了她的内裤。然后我给她口交了。

lines.en: scene chikatells26
: I think that part of me hoped she’d fall for me again. That she’d realize I like her the way she used to like me and stop chasing after you.
lines.zh: : 我想，我心底有一部分希望她会重新爱上我。希望她会意识到我对她的喜欢，就像她过去对我的喜欢那样，然后不再追着你跑。

lines.en: : But of course, I failed. And I confused the ever living {i}hell{/i} out of her in the process because she, at least up until then, thought all we were was friends. And I think she was right.
lines.zh: : 可当然，我失败了。而且我把她{i}彻底{/i}搞糊涂了——因为至少在那之前，她以为我们只是朋友。而我觉得她是对的。

lines.en: : I think I {i}ruined{/i} that. But even now, I can’t stop thinking about her. And I want to be {i}more{/i} than that. But I want to be more than that with {i}you{/i} too, so...what does this make me?
lines.zh: : 我想是我{i}毁{/i}了那件事。可即便是现在，我还是忍不住想她。我想要的{i}不止{/i}是朋友。可我对{i}你{/i}也想要不止是那样，所以……这算什么？

lines.en: : I want you. I want her. But I don’t want the two of you to have {i}each other.{/i} And I feel bad about that. But I also don’t {i}want{/i} to feel bad about that because I want you to understand what it’s like to be us.
lines.zh: : 我想要你。我想要她。可我不想让你们两个拥有{i}彼此{/i}。而我为此感到愧疚。可我也不{i}想{/i}为此愧疚，因为我想让你明白当「我们」是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene chikatells27
: Are you {i}mad{/i} at me?
lines.zh: : 你生我的{i}气{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Because you {i}should{/i} be.
lines.zh: : 因为你应{i}该{/i}生气。

lines.en: : You should feel betrayed and unwanted and lost and confused and all of the other things I’ve felt because of you.
lines.zh: : 你应该感到被背叛、不被需要、迷失、困惑，以及所有我因你而感受过的东西。

lines.en: : But you should also feel seen. Because someone finally gets it.
lines.zh: : 但你也应该感到被看见。因为终于有人懂了。

lines.en: : Because I finally understand what it’s like to love two people at once.
lines.zh: : 因为我终于明白了同时爱上两个人是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Can you still love me even if I am like this?
lines.zh: : 就算我是这样，你还能爱我吗？

lines.en: : You...
: What...What about {i}her,{/i} though? Because Rin is still freaking out since the two of you are-
lines.zh: : 那……那{i}她{/i}怎么办？因为 Rin 现在还在慌，既然你们两个——

lines.en: : The reason I’m able to talk to you right now is specifically {i}because{/i} I distanced myself from her.
lines.zh: : 我现在能跟你谈这些，正是{i}因为{/i}我主动疏远了她。

lines.en: : If I didn’t, it would have been the same thing all over again. Where I get so obsessed that nothing else matters and I wind up ruining the part of my life that I love.
lines.zh: : 如果不这样，一切又会重演。我会痴迷到别的一切都不重要，最后毁掉我生命中我爱的那部分。

lines.en: : And it’s better for her too. She’s less confused this way. And she can let you hurt her if that is truly what she wants.
lines.zh: : 而且这对她也更好。这样她没那么困惑。她可以让你去伤她，如果那真是她想要的。

lines.en: : I...have no idea what to say here.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道该说什么。

lines.en: : Like, I obviously don’t have the right to be mad, but-
lines.zh: : 比如，我显然没有生气的资格，可是——

lines.en: : Yes you do.
lines.zh: : 你有。

lines.en: : I’m your {i}girlfriend.{/i} Remember? And I went and cheated on you with somebody else.
lines.zh: : 我是你{i}女朋友{/i}。记得吗？而我跑去跟别人出轨了。

lines.en: : Yes. But I-
lines.zh: : 是。可我——

lines.en: : Two wrongs don’t make a right.
lines.zh: : 两个错误换不来一个正确。

lines.en: : Okay, but I have way more than just {i}two{/i} wrongs under my belt.
lines.zh: : 行吧，可我干过的错事可不止{i}两{/i}件。

lines.en: : Two, three, a thousand. I don’t think it really matters.
lines.zh: : 两件、三件、一千件。我觉得真没什么区别。

lines.en: : It always hurts when something or someone you’re passionate about winds up not being all it’s cracked up to be.
lines.zh: : 当你热爱的某件事、某个人最终并不像它被吹捧的那么好时，总是会疼。

lines.en: : And we’re both that to each other now. So the question is if we’ll {i}keep{/i} being that way or just...
lines.zh: : 而我们现在对彼此而言都是那样。所以问题在于，我们要{i}一直{/i}这样下去，还是就……

lines.en: : Run off somewhere else and...{i}be{/i} something else. If we even {i}can.{/i} If we’re not just kidding ourselves.
lines.zh: : 跑到别的什么地方去……{i}变成{/i}别的什么。如果我们真{i}能做到{/i}的话。如果我们不是在自欺欺人的话。

lines.en: : When did you realize you loved her?...
lines.zh: : 你是什么时候意识到你爱她的？……

lines.en: : That’s the cruelest part of all...
lines.zh: : 这才是所有事里最残忍的部分……

lines.en: scene black
: It was the second she realized she loves {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就在她意识到她爱{i}你{/i}的那一刻。

lines.en: scene chikatells28
: I’m sorry. I really am. But I have no regrets...and I think that means I’m growing.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉。真的。可我不后悔……我想这意味着我在成长。

lines.en: : Or regressing. It’s because of what you’re feeling that I {i}don’t{/i} grow and likely never will.
lines.zh: : 或者在倒退。正是因为你现在的感受，我才{i}无法{/i}成长，而且大概永远不会。

lines.en: : Don’t ever let anyone be ignorant for as long as I was again, okay? Just rip the bandage off next time and you’ll spare them all of the pain in the world.
lines.zh: : 别再让任何人像我那样被蒙在鼓里那么久，好吗？下次直接把创可贴撕掉，你就能替他们省下这世上所有的痛。

lines.en: : Not all of it. You’re hurting just as much now as you were when you found out about me.
lines.zh: : 不是所有的痛。你现在跟我被发现那会儿一样疼。

lines.en: : Yes, but some of this pain was my choice.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这份痛有一部分是我自己的选择。

lines.en: : And {i}all{/i} of my pain is my choice.
lines.zh: : 而我{i}所有{/i}的痛都是我的选择。

lines.en: : Not all of it. That’s just what it sounds like when you’ve given up.
lines.zh: : 不是全部。那只是你放弃时听起来像的话。

lines.en: : What happens now then?
lines.zh: : 那现在怎么办？

lines.en: : What happens now is you go meet up with Rin.
lines.zh: : 现在怎么办？你现在去跟 Rin 见面。

lines.en: : You take her somewhere nice. You don’t mention anything about me. You make her smile and realize how wonderful she is. And you treasure her.
lines.zh: : 带她去个好地方。别提我的任何事。让她笑起来，让她意识到自己有多好。然后珍惜她。

lines.en: : It’s really that easy. It just {i}feels{/i} hard whenever you remember everything else that exists.
lines.zh: : 真的就是这么简单。只有在你想起其他一切存在的事物时，它才{i}显得{/i}很难。

lines.en: : I meant with {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说{i}我们{/i}之间。

lines.en: : What happens to you and me?
lines.zh: : 你和我怎么办？

lines.en: : I suppose that depends on whether or not you can still look at me without being overcome by rage.
lines.zh: : 我想，这取决于你还能不能看着我而不被怒火淹没。

lines.en: : Does that get easier with time?
lines.zh: : 那会随时间变容易吗？

lines.en: : A little bit. My blood still boils when I look into your eyes and remember all the lies, though.
lines.zh: : 会一点。不过当我看着你的眼睛、想起所有那些谎言时，我的血还是会沸腾。

lines.en: : I won’t lie anymore. Not to you, at least.
lines.zh: : 我不会再撒谎了。至少不对你撒。

lines.en: : But to everyone else?
lines.zh: : 可对其他所有人还是会？

lines.en: : Can I...hug you? Please?
lines.zh: : 我能……抱你吗？求你了？

lines.en: scene chikatells29
: You don’t need to ask, idiot.
lines.zh: : 你不用问，笨蛋。

lines.en: : I feel like I do now. Is this what it’s like to live in shame?
lines.zh: : 可我觉得现在需要问了。活在羞耻里就是这个感觉吗？

lines.en: : You have nothing to feel ashamed about. You didn’t get enough love from me, so you just looked for it somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 你没什么好羞耻的。你没从我这儿得到足够的爱，所以就去别处找了。

lines.en: : Does this mean you don’t get enough from me?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着你也没从我这儿得到足够的爱？

lines.en: : That I could have prevented all of this if I just loved you a little more?
lines.zh: : 如果我能多爱你一点，这一切是不是就不会发生？

lines.en: : Chika...
lines.zh: : Chika……

lines.en: scene black
: If you loved me any more, I imagine we’d both be dead by now.
lines.zh: : 要是你再多爱我一点，我想我们俩现在都该死了。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : Maybe we {i}should{/i} be...
lines.zh: : 也许我们应{i}该{/i}……
